A field guide to an inhabited world · volume IX · the jelly family

Slimes

Five slime monster girls made of living jelly: verdant, magma, honey, frost and amethyst. You can see right through them, and what they have eaten floats inside. They bounce, they split when hurt, and they become whatever you feed them.

I · HarpiesII · Bullywugs & Mucus ToadsIII · NekomataIV · KitsuneV · LamiaVI · ArachneVII · CentaursVIII · MerfolkIX · SlimesX · JackalopesXI · MinotaursXII · MollusksXIII · ElvesXIV · UndeadXV · LizardfolkXVI · DragonsXVII · DevilsXVIII · BugsXIX · FloraXX · CanidsXXI · RodentsXXII · CrustaceansXXIII · MarsupialsXXIV · ArmouredXXV · ConstructsXXVI · BatsXXVII · TheropodsXXVIII · The Four Riders
The central similarity

You are what you eat.

A slime girl is a translucent body around a bright core. She absorbs what she eats and keeps it inside where you can see it, takes her colour from her diet, and grows or shrinks with how well she is fed. Feeding is everything to this family.

  • AbsorbShe swallows dropped items and keeps them inside (9 slots, visible). Devoted, she is your living storage.
  • Diet colourFeed her a dye and she shifts to the matching colour of her species (the five variants).
  • SplitA killing blow splits her into two small halves that find each other and merge again (once a day).
  • BounceNo fall damage, and anything that lands on her bounces like on a slime block.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a slime builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Her favourite food (see each species)
  • Hugs (petting; she wobbles happily)
  • Dyes she likes (and does not mind changing colour)
  • Shiny things to absorb

What costs trust

  • Any hit (she is fragile: a hit halves her affection)
  • Taking items back out of her without asking (outside of devotion)
  • Fire, for every slime but the magma slime

Devoted (60+)

Her body becomes your 9-slot living storage, she follows you everywhere, and her element works for you (see each species).

Mating & young

FormBudding. YoungSlimelings (2-3), grown in 5 days. WhereWherever she rests. Slimelings use the adult model at 35% scale; they are blobs with a face.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may slide into your bed at night (she is cool and squishy). By morning she is expecting: her core grows a bright second centre over the day.
2. BuddingHer core divides and she buds off two or three slimelings: little blobs that pop off her side, each of her species, in a random colour.
3. SlimelingsSlimelings bounce after their mother, absorb small things (seeds, sticks) and sometimes merge into one bigger slimeling when they collide.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to their father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

AbsorbShe picks up and absorbs dropped items she likes (her species' favourites, and anything shiny). They float inside her body. A devoted slime opens as a 9-slot inventory for her player (sneak and use an empty hand).
Diet colourDyes shift her colour: each of her five colours has a dye. Her favourite food also heals her and builds affection.
Split & mergeWhen she would die she splits in two at a quarter health each, and the halves merge back within a minute (once per day). The second time she dies for real.
BounceShe takes no fall damage and bounces players and mobs that land on her. She adores anything bouncy herself: give her a slime block or a bed and she bounces on it, squealing.
ElementEach species carries her element: verdant grows plants, magma cooks food, honey slows, frost freezes water under her, amethyst rings near ore.
DaylightSlimes rest in shade at noon (they warm up and go floppy) and are liveliest at dusk, at night and in rain.

Species profiles

Swamps & slime chunksClassic · cheerful

Verdant Slime (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentCheerful, clingy, simple

Ecology & behaviourThe classic green slime girl, from the same swamps and underground slime chunks as vanilla slimes. Bounces everywhere, hums, and leaves plants growing where she naps.

Signature: Garden jellyCrops and saplings within 4 blocks of where she rests grow faster (a bone meal tick every half minute). Devoted, she follows you and fertilises as she goes.

Player interactionGive her slime balls and apples. Let her nap in your garden.

Colour variants

Lime (default) · Bright lime jelly, a green coreMint · Pale mintOlive · Murky oliveTeal · Blue-greenMoss gold · Yellow-green with a golden core

Spawns inswamp, mangrove_swamp, lush_caves

DangerNone.

Nether & lava lakesHot-headed · warm

Magma Slime (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentHot-headed, warm-hearted, impatient

Ecology & behaviourMolten jelly around a burning core. Lives in the Nether and by lava lakes, never takes fire damage, and glows in the dark.

Signature: Living furnaceHand her raw food and she gives it back cooked (one item every few seconds). She glows (light) and sets nothing on fire unless angry.

Player interactionBring magma cream. Keep her away from water.

Colour variants

Ember (default) · Orange-red with a yellow coreCinder · Dark crust over glowing cracksBlue flame · Soul-fire blueWhite hot · Pale yellow-whiteCrimson · Deep red

Spawns inbasalt_deltas, nether_wastes, crimson_forest

DangerLow: touching her when she is angry burns.

Flower forests & meadowsSweet · sticky

Honey Slime (about 1.5 blocks)

TemperamentSweet, slow, sleepy

Ecology & behaviourLives among bee nests. Bees treat her as one of their own. Everything that touches her sticks a little.

Signature: Sticky & beloved by beesMobs that touch her get Slowness. Bees never sting her bonded player while she is near. Hand her a glass bottle and she fills it with honey (once an hour).

Player interactionGive her honey and flowers. Never smoke out the bees she lives with.

Colour variants

Spawns inflower_forest, meadow, sunflower_plains, cherry_grove

DangerNone.

Frozen peaks & iceCool · calm

Frost Slime (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentCalm, cool-headed, quietly funny

Ecology & behaviourLiving ice jelly with snowflakes drifting inside. Water freezes under her, and she rests in the coldest places she can find.

Signature: ChillWater under her freezes (frost walker). Bonded, she puts out a burning player she touches and gives Fire Resistance for ten seconds (once a minute).

Player interactionGive her ice and snowballs. Keep her out of the Nether.

Ice blue (default) · Clear ice blueGlacier · Milky white-blueAurora · Green and violetDeep · Deep sea blueSnow pink · Pale pink, like snow at sunset

Spawns infrozen_peaks, ice_spikes, frozen_ocean, snowy_slopes, deep_frozen_ocean

Geodes & dripstone cavesDreamy · crystalline

Amethyst Slime (about 1.55 blocks)

TemperamentDreamy, musical, a little absent-minded

Ecology & behaviourJelly grown around amethyst crystals in geodes. She chimes when she moves and hums with the crystals.

Signature: ResonanceShe glows and chimes faster the nearer she is to ore (iron, gold, diamond, emerald within 8 blocks): an ore finder. Devoted, she brings amethyst shards and an occasional quartz or diamond.

Player interactionBring amethyst shards. Listen to her chime.

Colour variants

Spawns indripstone_caves, deep_dark, lush_caves

DangerNone.

Made, not foundTwo in one · marbled

Mixed Slime (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentTwo moods at once

Ecology & behaviourTwo slime girls of different kinds who trust the same player can flow together into one marbled slime. She is both of them: a killing blow does not split her into halves, it separates her back into the two she was.

Signature: Two in oneOne slime carrying both girls, their bonds and their belongings. Never lost: hurt badly, she comes apart into the two again.

Player interactionHold a slime ball and right-click one of two slimes (of different kinds, both at high friendship with you) standing together. Sneak and do it again to separate them.

Mimic (about 1.5 blocks)

TemperamentGreedy, then devoted

Ecology & behaviourA slime who lives in a treasure chest and keeps its loot inside her. She waits in dungeons and mineshafts.

Signature: Treasure chestOne unopened loot chest in eight is a mimic: she bites once and keeps the loot. Gold wins her over; then she follows you and her loot is yours (crouch and right-click to open her).

Player interactionOpen a loot chest at your own risk. Feed her gold.

TemperamentShy, light-fingered

Ecology & behaviourA slime that ate an ender pearl: she flickers from place to place and moves the world around a block at a time.

Copper Slime (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentBright

Ecology & behaviourA slime of living copper. She weathers like the blocks do, from bright metal to green, and a little vain about it.

Signature: WeatheringShe ages a stage every forty minutes. Honeycomb waxes her, an axe scrapes her back. Lightning polishes her all the way, and she stores the charge as speed for her friend.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Absorbing items; devoted 9-slot living storage
  • Dye colours
  • Split and merge instead of death (once a day)
  • No fall damage
  • A hit halves her trust
  • Verdant garden growth, magma cooking and glow, honey stickiness and bottles, frost freezing and fire rescue, amethyst ore resonance
  • Budding into 2-3 slimelings
  • Copper Slime: weathers stage by stage, honeycomb waxes her, an axe scrapes her back, lightning polishes her
  • Klabuster: befriended, every half minute the crops near her friend grow a stage
  • Undine: keeps the farmland near her watered, fills cauldrons, Water Breathing for her friend in the water
  • Bouncing happily on slime blocks and beds
  • Ender slime: teleports away from blows and water; while wild she picks up loose blocks and sets them down elsewhere; endermites are her kin

Not yet

  • Bees sparing her player
  • Resting in shade at noon
  • Bouncing players that land on her

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • Slimes take their colour from dyes, so their five colours are a choice the player makes, not only a spawn roll.
  • The body is translucent (a translucent render type) around an opaque core bone.
  • Split instead of death once a day keeps a beloved slime from being lost to one bad fall.

Open questions

  • Should two slime species be able to merge into a mixed slime?
  • Should a slime's inventory spill out when she splits?
